questions.prompt: Which combination best reflects the scope of flood crisis management in this course?
options: Preparedness, response, recovery and long-term resilience
Only post-flood reconstruction
Only numerical modelling
Only public communication
questions.answer: Preparedness, response, recovery and long-term resilience

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of situational awareness during an evolving flood crisis?
options: To build a shared understanding of what is happening, what may happen next and what the consequences could be
To replace all field observations with one forecast
To delay decisions until uncertainty disappears
To focus only on long-term climate policy
questions.answer: To build a shared understanding of what is happening, what may happen next and what the consequences could be

questions.prompt: How can flood-wave propagation and inundation forecasting support crisis management?
options: By helping anticipate where flooding may develop and supporting timely decisions
By guaranteeing that flood defences will not fail
By eliminating the need for stakeholder coordination
By replacing flood-risk assessment
questions.answer: By helping anticipate where flooding may develop and supporting timely decisions

questions.prompt: Why are dike and levee inspections relevant during a flood crisis?
options: They provide field information about flood-defence condition that can contribute to the wider crisis picture
They are only useful after a crisis is completely over
They remove the need for forecasting
They are unrelated to emergency response
questions.answer: They provide field information about flood-defence condition that can contribute to the wider crisis picture

questions.prompt: How should AI-based forecasting approaches be used in the crisis-management context described in the course?
options: As decision-support information interpreted together with other evidence and local context
As an automatic replacement for human decision-making
Only after the recovery phase
Without communicating uncertainty or context
questions.answer: As decision-support information interpreted together with other evidence and local context
